text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> alert: synthetic-canary-5m-latency (rule: canary-latency > 300ms)
Maya: acked on call, looking
Maya: seeing a burst of 5m canary p50 spikes across eu-west-1 synthetic job, not seeing backend errors yet
Glen: @Maya do we have evidence for real user impact or just synthetic?
Maya: quick check — PROD metrics dashboard shows no elevated 99p latency on customer routes, only canary-series-5m stream spiking
incident-bot: escalation: routed to next on-call (Ash) after 60s no-ack
Ash: on it, joining
Priya: pinging infra-side too in case it's infra scheduler churn, but no infra alerts in the last 10m
Carlos: saw similar in staging yesterday after a noisy cron, could be job overlap causing synthetic probes to queue
Maya: can we mute pagerduty for this alert temporarily? It's flapping fast and auto-resolving every 30-45s
Glen: +1 to mute, but prefer to collect a short thread of evidence before muting so we don't hide real faults
Ash: agreed — grabbing a sample window and saving traces. If no customer impact after 2 cycles we mute for 15m and add follow-up ticket
Maya: sample query I ran:
```
metric: synthetic_canary_latency_ms{canary="5m",region="eu-west-1"}
|> histogram_quantile(0.5)
|> last_over_time(1m)
```
Maya: output shows bursts to ~450ms then fall back under 120ms, repeat ~every 40s
Ash: pulling traces from the canary runner now, sharing logs
Ash: logs show the canary pod restarting briefly around the spikes, container exit code 137 on the runner side
Carlos: exit 137 => OOM maybe? Which node group for the canary runners?
Priya: canary-runner pool is on k8s autoscale nodepool-small, preemptible instances in eu-west-1; recent noisier GCE preemption events reported in the region earlier today
Glen: that matches preemptible churn causing the canary pod to bounce — synthetic will flash even if user traffic unaffected
Maya: I propose: mute PD rule synthetic-canary-5m-latency for 15m, annotate issue pointing to preemptible churn, and set follow-up to move canaries to non-preemptible or add retry backoff
Ash: will create PD mute now and add a note with logs + traces. Muting command (PD web): click alert -> More -> Mute for 15 minutes. Or via PD API:
```bash
pd alerts update --id $ALERT_ID --mute true --until "$(date -d '+15 minutes' --iso-8601=seconds)"
```
Maya: muted the PD alert for 15m, added note: "muted — canary pod OOM/restart (exit 137), likely preemptible instance churn; no customer impact observed" :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by Maya and muted by Ash
Priya: thanks. I'll add a short runbook step to mark synthetic canaries as non-preemptible and add jitter to cron to avoid synchronized starts
Carlos: opening infra ticket: INFRA-7272 to evaluate canary nodepool and eviction resilience
Glen: next steps in thread: 1) infra ticket, 2) move canaries to non-preemptible or use podDisruptionBudget + descheduling jitter, 3) tune alert to require two successive 1m windows > threshold before paging
Maya: agreed. No customer-facing impact, closing on-call loop. Will handoff any follow-ups to SRE backlog and tag the alert for tuning
Ash: logging follow-up items into SRE board, attaching logs and trace IDs 7612a, 7613b
Maya: marking thread resolved locally — auto-resolves kept happening but we muted and investigated quickly. Thanks team :eyes: :heart:
Glen: nice quick triage, good call on mute + follow-up.
incident-bot: thread closed by Maya (action: mute + follow-up ticket INFRA-7272).
